module: "Hero Road" editor: creation and editing of roads by splines (road groups with nodes, profiles, layers, mesh, sidewalks, barriers, lighting and placed objects, terraforming, painting, export). The associated modules are in editor/heroRoadEditor/ (groupMgr, layerMgr, profile, mesh, exportMgr, sidewalkMgr, barrierMgr, placeablesUI, import) and editor/toolUtilities/. It registers the "Hero Road" edit mode and a scene tree context menu "Convert to Hero Road" to import selected DecalRoads. The roads' state survives a Lua reload via onSerialize/onDeserialized.
notes: The displayName of the edit mode ("Hero Road") must equal groupMgr.getToolPrefixStr(): splineInput recognizes a node's owner by comparing bestHit.toolName to editor.editMode.displayName; otherwise the tool reactivates on every click.
Hardcoded constants: default spline width 10 m, RDP simplification tolerance 9.0, layer edge offset from -5 to 5 m.
The setters setSelectedSplineIdx/setSelectedNodeIdx have no bounds checking: they write the index directly.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called when leaving the map: deletes all road groups and recomputes the id to index table.

onDeserialized.desc: Deserialization hook after Lua reload: recreates the road groups from the data and recomputes the id to index table. Accepts the old format (bare array of groups).

data.desc: Table {groups = {...}} returned by onSerialize, or old array of groups

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every frame by the editor: the tool's main callback. Handles hiding during drags (node, crosswalk, corner handle, "live" cursor), rebuilding of modified groups, rendering of the splines and the tool window.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: registers the "Hero Road" edit mode, the tool window, the material selection window and the "Convert to Hero Road" scene tree menu entry.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before a Lua reload: serializes all road groups, then deletes them (removeAllGroups).

setSelectedNodeIdx.desc: Sets the index of the selected node (selection shared between tools).

idx.desc: Index of the node in the selected spline

setSelectedSplineIdx.desc: Sets the index of the selected spline (road group) (selection shared between tools).

idx.desc: Index of the group in the group list
